My heart breaks for Wendy, who was finally able to return to the US to bury her 3-year-old son, Orlin.

We must never forget Orlin and how ICE ignored Wendy’s pleas when they separated her from her son. Family separation is cruel and it must be stopped. wapo.st/49v354O

Ticket prices are out of control.

The reason why has gotten super political. Here’s how:

Video

For too long, ICE has operated without consequences. But today’s arrest of an ICE agent who is accused of lying and shooting someone in Minneapolis is an important step toward justice.

ICE will be held accountable — even if the Trump administration refuses to do so.
nytimes.com/2026/05/29/us/ic…

Reminder: Republicans could have stopped Trump’s war with Iran a long time ago.

They even cancelled last week’s vote on a War Powers Resolution because they were afraid it would pass. Spineless.
time.com/article/2026/05/22/…

NEW: A judge just temporarily BLOCKED the Trump administration from moving ahead with their $1.8 BILLION slush fund to pay insurrectionists and MAGA loyalists.

I’ve said from the start that this is an absolute waste of taxpayer dollars. This needs to be stopped permanently.

The Trump administration violated federal law and is being blatantly racist in their refugee admissions policies.

Let me explain.

Video

This DOJ is acting as Trump’s personal law firm, not in the interest of the American people.

Video

Inflation jumped once again and Americans are now saving at one of the lowest rates in the past 20 years.

Trump said he doesn’t think about your financial situation. The data proves it.

I'm sending my deepest condolences to the Longview community as they grieve and recover from this tragedy. I'm grateful to the first responders who continue their recovery efforts.
seattletimes.com/seattle-new…

Trump’s latest idea: Putting himself on a new $250 bill.

Ridiculous. So many Americans can barely even afford a $250 emergency.
wapo.st/4fM4Hei

Jeffery Epstein, Ghislaine Maxwell, and all of the other predators in the Epstein files are just the tip of the iceberg.

We need a release of the full files and to get justice for ALL survivors of sexual assault and trafficking, and to hold every single abuser accountable.

Video

Wishing all who celebrate a blessed and joyful Eid al-Adha!

I hope today brings you peace and love among family and neighbors. Eid Mubarak!

Big Tech spent at least $653 MILLION to cozy up to Trump and Republicans — and now they’re cashing in BIG.

This is the oligarchy in action and we must fight back by overturning Citizens United, abolishing Super PACs, and implementing serious regulations on AI.

Video

The Trump administration has weaponized the DOJ to go after their political enemies and protect their billionaire buddies — all with no checks from the Supreme Court or Republicans in Congress.

This cannot continue. Congress must step up and enforce our checks and balances.

Video

Trump isn’t going after the “worst of the worst” — he’s going after all immigrants. And we must be clear eyed about this — he’s using immigrants as a testing ground for stripping Constitutional protections for ALL of us.

Video

Kids should be playing with their friends, learning at school, and going home to see their families. No child should be ripped away from their family, held in detention.

Any country that detains children has lost its moral compass.

Video

Trump is acting like an authoritarian — and it’s not just hurting us here at home, it’s affecting people across the globe. 

From his illegal war of choice in Iran to the boat strikes in the Caribbean, he is acting without respect for democracy or the rule of law.

Video

The President of the United States traded TENS of MILLIONS of dollars in stocks this year.

This should be illegal. Members of Congress, the President, and Vice President should ALL be banned from trading stocks. That’s why I’m leading bipartisan efforts to do just that.

Video

As Americans come together for cookouts this long weekend, they’re paying more for the basics. 

Thanks to Trump’s illegal war and inflation, grocery prices are up on everything from corn to sodas.

This Memorial Day, we remember and honor the brave servicemembers who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.

We keep them and their families in our hearts.
